title: Road Hazard Protection Repair Standards and Claim Limits
content:
## Covered damage, repair standard and claim counts

Road Hazard Protection covers only the damage types the plan lists, never a cause the plan excludes, and only after a Crestline technician has inspected the tire for a repair or replacement claim. A puncture is repaired rather than replaced only within the size, zone and tread limits below, by the plan's repair method. Each wheel position has its own repair limit and each certificate its own limit of claim numbers.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Covered damage types | tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break | tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break | tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break | tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break, bead damage | tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break, bead damage | tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break, bead damage |
| Excluded causes | collision, vandalism, off-road use, racing, run-flat driving | collision, vandalism, off-road use, racing, run-flat driving | collision, vandalism, off-road use, racing, run-flat driving | collision, vandalism, off-road use, racing, run-flat driving | collision, vandalism, off-road use, racing, run-flat driving | collision, vandalism, racing, run-flat driving |
| Technician inspection before a repair or replacement claim | required | required | required | required | required | required |
| Largest puncture repaired, inches | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 |
| Repairable zone | tread area only | tread area only | tread area only | tread area only | tread area only | tread area only |
| Repair method | patch-plug combination | patch-plug combination | patch-plug combination | patch-plug combination | patch-plug combination | patch-plug combination |
| Tread at or below which a puncture is not repaired | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 3/32 inch |
| Covered repairs per wheel position over the term | 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 4 |
| Claim numbers per certificate over the term | 4 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 8 |

**How the claim limit counts.** Repairs, replacements, reimbursements and roadside services all draw on the same limit of claim numbers per certificate; each distinct claim number counts once.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**
- A tread-area puncture of 0.25 inch on a tire with 5/32 inch of tread left is within the repair standard on every plan; one of 0.30 inch is not.
- On the Commercial LT plan a tread puncture on a tire with 3/32 inch of tread left is not repaired; on the other plans the same tire is above their 2/32 inch figure.
- Off-road use voids a claim on the five consumer plans; it is not an excluded cause on the Commercial LT plan.
